blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Pope Leo XIV has approved the election of Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle as dean of the College of Cardinals. The approval comes following the resignation of 92-year-old Cardinal Giovanni Battista Re, who had held the post since January 2020.
